      public WidgetSearchBar(net.minecraft.client.gui.Font font, int x, int y, int width, boolean lineMode, String initialValue, Consumer<String> changeCallback, IntConsumer navigateCallback, Runnable closeCallback)
      Parameters:
      lineMode - If a line number is entered instead of a text to find.
      changeCallback - Called when the input changes.
      navigateCallback - Called with 1 to go to the next match (or the line), and -1 to go to the previous match.
      closeCallback - Called when the bar should be closed.
